additional_manual_verification: Weight sum in floating point: 0.15+0.15+0.10+0.10+0.15+0.15+0.10+0.10 === 1 exactly (no drift).
Each of the 8 dimensions independently isolated at value=100 reproduces its documented weight exactly (15/15/10/10/15/15/10/10) - confirms no weight transposition or drift.
clampScore(NaN)=0, clampScore(+Infinity)=0, clampScore(-Infinity)=0, clampScore(-50)=0, clampScore(500)=100 - all verified directly, not just via the existing test file.

Non-finite safety verified beyond the single existing test case: a -Infinity dimension and a NaN dimension each independently zero out only their own weighted contribution (e.g. all-100 with capitalEfficiency=-Infinity => 90 = 100-10; with marketTiming=NaN => 90 = 100-10) rather than corrupting the whole score or producing a false high score.

recommendationFor() also internally clamps its opportunityScore/confidence parameters, so passing non-finite context values (e.g. Infinity/Infinity) safely degrades to ARCHIVE rather than a false BUILD - extends the non-finite-safety property beyond just the 8 scoring dimensions.

Blocker precedence verified with combinations not present in the original test suite: structurallyWeakOrDominated=true AND informationGapPrimaryBlocker=true => KILL wins (matches documented precedence order 1-6); informationGapPrimaryBlocker=true AND timingOrDependencyBlocked=true => RESEARCH wins.

Confirmed via git log that packages/core/src/scoring.ts and scoring.test.ts have been touched by exactly one commit (ad98088, the PR #7 merge) in the repo's entire history - zero drift from subsequent Mission 3 (PR #8) or Mission 3.5 queue (PR #9) merges.

non_blocking_followups.summary: Mission/control record names 'PR #5' as the audit target, but PR #5 is closed/unmerged; the shipped implementation is PR #7 (merged, replaying the same 5 files from PR #5's branch onto a refreshed base). Recommend updating control-plane/mission references to cite PR #7 as the merged source of truth to avoid future confusion about which PR is canonical.

pnpm-lock.yaml is out of sync with packages/core/package.json's devDependencies (@types/node, tsx, typescript): 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile' fails. Not currently a real CI risk because .github/workflows/ci.yml explicitly runs 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false', but a future stricter install mode would silently break. Recommend regenerating/committing an up-to-date lockfile.

opportunityScore() rounds its weighted result to 1 decimal place (Math.round(score*10)/10) before any caller would compare it against the integer BUILD/VALIDATE thresholds (80/65). This is undocumented in docs/SCORING_MODEL.md and can nudge a raw value like 79.95 up to a compared 80.0, crossing the BUILD boundary purely from rounding. Not a defect in the audited functions (both are independently pure/tested and recommendationFor() takes score as an explicit parameter), but should be documented for whoever wires prediction storage/display so threshold semantics stay unambiguous.

INCUBATE requires score >= 65 in code (timingOrDependencyBlocked && score >= 65), but neither docs/SCORING_MODEL.md nor docs/SCORING_VALIDATION.md states this numeric threshold explicitly (only 'strong potential'/'otherwise strong opportunities'). Recommend documenting the 65 threshold so the implementation stays traceable to spec.
